name: Thailand

flag.description: Five horizontal stripes of red, white, blue, white and red, with the central blue stripe twice as tall as each of the others.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the nation, white religion and blue the monarchy.

hook: Thailand is red-white-BLUE-white-red with a thick blue belt; Costa Rica uses the same pattern with the colours swapped (blue outside, red in the middle).
trivia: The flag is called the Trairong, "tricolour", and was adopted in 1917 by King Vajiravudh, replacing a flag with a white elephant on red.
Thailand is the only country in Southeast Asia never colonised by a European power.
